NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 9 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 8 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 4, 8:53 PM ET

Jaxon Smith-Njigba is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 9 DraftKings main slate at 22.3 DraftKings points for $9,300, against Arizona. Puka Nacua (21.9, $8,800) and CeeDee Lamb (18.4, $8,300) are next.

Puka Nacua returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 2.49 projected points per $1,000 at $8,800.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 4, 8:53 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 9

Jaxon Smith-Njigba, SEA vs ARI ($9,300)

Jaxon Smith-Njigba carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 22.3 DraftKings points at $9,300, the 4th-highest on the entire main slate. That is 0.4 points clear of Puka Nacua. The model gives him 9.2 targets on 26.4 routes. The salary works out to 2.40 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 34 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Smith-Njigba averaged 22.4 points with a simulated floor of 9.0 and a ceiling of 47.3, and he holds 18% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Seattle is an 8.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 24 in a game totaled at 39.5.

Puka Nacua, LAR at WAS ($8,800)

Puka Nacua projects 2nd at the position with 21.9 DraftKings points at $8,800, 5th on the main slate overall. The model gives him 10.7 targets on 30.6 routes. The salary works out to 2.49 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 34 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Nacua averaged 22.0 points with a simulated floor of 8.2 and a ceiling of 46.5, and he holds 24% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Rams are a 5.5-point favorite on the road against Washington, with an implied team total of 26.5 in a game totaled at 47.5.

CeeDee Lamb, DAL at IND ($8,300)

CeeDee Lamb projects 3rd at the position with 18.4 DraftKings points at $8,300. The model gives him 9.9 targets on 32.0 routes. The salary works out to 2.22 projected points per $1,000, 9th of 34 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Lamb averaged 18.5 points with a simulated floor of 5.5 and a ceiling of 42.6, and he holds 15% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 5.5-point favorite on the road against Indianapolis, with an implied team total of 28.5 in a game totaled at 51.5.

Value: Malik Washington, MIA vs DET ($4,700)

Malik Washington projects for 10.9 DraftKings points at $4,700, which works out to 2.31 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 34 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 6.6 targets on 25.1 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Washington averaged 10.9 points with a simulated floor of 3.0 and a ceiling of 26.4, and he holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Miami is a 7-point underdog at home against Detroit, with an implied team total of 21.75 in a game totaled at 50.5.
